notes: At 3:30 the minute hand is at 180° and the hour hand at 3·30°+30·0.5° = 105°; |180−105| = 75°, and 360−75 = 285°, so the non-reflex angle is unambiguously 75°. The value is exact (integer degrees) and in simplest form. 'Angle between the clock hands' conventionally denotes the smaller (non-reflex) angle, so the branch choice is standard and unambiguous.
